title: Brightever 4x4 3.5x3.5 Solar Post Cap Lights 8-Pack White

comparisons.notes: Same MPN OKDMX-KN-SPL-04, UPC 669225037552, white 4x4 8-pack; sold as Open Box/Like New

writeup: Woot has an 8-pack of Brightever solar post cap lights in white for $24.99, which works out to about $3.12 per light. They fit 4x4 posts (3.5 x 3.5 inch), have 16 LEDs each and a switch for warm or cool white. The same set runs $45.77 at Retailking as open box. Limit 3 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Exact match by ASIN, MPN OKDMX-KN-SPL-04 and UPC 669225037552 (white, 4x4, 8-pack)
